title: Airport Flex Park seller's listing summary
summary: Airport Flex Park · The seller's broker

evidence.quote: Sample Seller Holdings LLC has engaged Fictional Industrial Partners as its exclusive broker for the sale of Airport Flex Park.
All offers are to be sent to Fictional Industrial Partners.
The property is 24,000 rentable square feet in 12 units at 6230 Runway Vista Drive, Las Vegas, NV 89119.
The broker's commission is paid by the seller; the buyer pays no commission.
